title: A dataset recorded during development of an affective brain-computer music interface: training sessions
description: EEG, galvanic skin response (GSR) and electrocardiogram (ECG) recordings from 16 healthy participants who listened to 40 s synthetically generated music clips targeting two affective states defined by valence and arousal. Data were collected over three sessions on separate days, each with four runs of 18 trials. The recordings were made to train an affective brain-computer music interface (BCMI-MIdAS) to induce target emotional states in individual users. Self-reported valence and arousal values and auxiliary variables are included.
methods_description: Participants completed 3 sessions on separate days, each with 4 runs of 18 trials. In each trial they listened to a 40 s music clip from a synthetic music generator. The first 20 s targeted one affective state and the last 20 s targeted another. EEG, GSR and ECG were recorded at 1 kHz, and participants reported valence and arousal.
